name: app_up
title: Application HTTP availability
description: 1 when the local application health check succeeds; 0 when it fails.

name: app_metrics_up
title: Private metrics availability
description: 1 when the private socket returns a valid fresh snapshot; 0 otherwise.

name: app_collector_up
title: Application collector heartbeat
description: 1 while the collector is publishing; expires after 120 seconds if the collector stops.

name: app_database_up
title: Database aggregate query health
description: 1 when aggregate queries succeed; 0 on failure. Activity totals are omitted on query failure.

name: app_snapshot_age_seconds
title: Application snapshot age
description: Age of the successfully retrieved application snapshot. Missing when the snapshot is unavailable.

name: app_http_requests_per_min
title: Completed requests / minute
description: Count in the rolling 60-second window. Health checks and private metrics requests are excluded. Only requests reaching Node.js are counted.

name: app_http_2xx_per_min
title: Successful HTTP responses / minute
description: Count in the rolling 60-second window. Health checks and private metrics requests are excluded. Only requests reaching Node.js are counted.

name: app_http_3xx_per_min
title: Redirect responses / minute
description: Count in the rolling 60-second window. Health checks and private metrics requests are excluded. Only requests reaching Node.js are counted.

name: app_http_4xx_per_min
title: Client error responses / minute
description: Count in the rolling 60-second window. Health checks and private metrics requests are excluded. Only requests reaching Node.js are counted.

name: app_http_5xx_per_min
title: Server error responses / minute
description: Count in the rolling 60-second window. Health checks and private metrics requests are excluded. Only requests reaching Node.js are counted.

name: app_http_aborted_per_min
title: Aborted HTTP responses / minute
description: Count in the rolling 60-second window. Health checks and private metrics requests are excluded. Only requests reaching Node.js are counted.

name: app_http_inflight
title: In-flight HTTP requests
description: Current requests being handled by Node.js; excludes health and private monitoring.

name: app_http_response_avg_ms
title: Mean response time (60s)
description: Mean time from Node.js handler entry until response finish, over completed requests in the rolling 60-second window. Zero with no samples.

name: app_http_response_p95_ms
title: P95 response time (60s)
description: 95th percentile of request duration over the rolling 60-second window, computed before exporting using a bounded histogram with two significant digits (about 1% precision). Zero with no samples. Long-range RRD consolidation averages these window percentiles.

name: app_http_5xx_percent
title: Server error percentage (60s)
description: Completed HTTP 5xx responses divided by all completed responses over the rolling 60-second window. Zero with no requests.

name: app_login_failures_per_min
title: Failed sign-in requests / minute
description: Login and PIN-migration requests returning HTTP 4xx/5xx, including validation failures and rate limits; rolling 60 seconds.

name: app_route_auth_per_min
title: Auth requests / minute
description: Completed requests in the fixed auth route category over the rolling 60-second window. Dynamic IDs and query strings are never exported.

name: app_route_profiles_per_min

name: app_process_rss_bytes
title: Node.js resident memory
description: Resident memory of the application process.

name: app_process_heap_used_bytes
title: Node.js used heap
description: Used JavaScript heap of the application process.

name: app_process_heap_total_bytes
title: Node.js total heap
description: Allocated JavaScript heap.

name: app_process_external_bytes
title: Node.js external memory
description: Memory of C++ objects bound to JavaScript objects.

name: app_process_cpu_percent
title: Node.js CPU utilization
description: Process CPU time divided by wall time over the latest 15-second sample; 100% equals one CPU core.

name: app_event_loop_utilization_percent
title: Event-loop utilization
description: Busy event-loop time as a percentage over the latest 15-second sample.

name: app_event_loop_delay_p95_ms
title: P95 event-loop delay
description: Node.js monitorEventLoopDelay at 20 ms resolution over the latest 15-second sample.

name: app_process_uptime_seconds
title: Application uptime
description: Seconds since the current Node.js process started; resets on restart.

name: app_members_total
title: Registered member accounts
description: Current member accounts, excluding owners/admins. Deletion reduces this gauge.

name: app_members_suspended
title: Suspended member accounts
description: Current suspended member accounts.

name: app_registrations_24h
title: Registrations in 24 hours
description: Current member records created in the previous 24 hours; deleted accounts are excluded.

name: app_profiles_published
title: Published profiles
description: Current published profile count.

name: app_introductions_total
title: Total introductions
description: Current introduction records; deletion may reduce this gauge.

name: app_introductions_pending
title: Pending introductions
description: Current pending introduction count.

name: app_connections_accepted
title: Accepted connections
description: Current accepted connection count.

name: app_introductions_24h
title: Introductions in 24 hours
description: Current introductions created in the previous 24 hours.

name: app_connections_accepted_24h
title: Connections accepted in 24 hours
description: Current accepted connections updated in the previous 24 hours.

name: app_messages_24h
title: Messages in 24 hours
description: Current message records created in the previous 24 hours; message content is not read.

name: app_visits_24h
title: Visits started in 24 hours
description: Visit records started in the previous 24 hours; not unique users.

name: app_authenticated_sessions
title: Unexpired signed-in sessions
description: Unexpired authenticated sessions. This is not an online-user count.
